coursedescription: This course is composed of two parts. The first part focuses on i) the basic principles and mechanics of Clear Aligner Treatment (CAT) and ii) clinical cases review. The second part is the use of Temporary Anchorage Devices (TADs) in Clinical Orthodontics. Topics cover from the consideration of TADs placement to clinical application. This course includes lectures and final examinations Fall 0.75 Credit Hours
